simple.summary: שַׂעַר (saʻar) means a terror First listed occurrence: Ezek 27 35.

definitions.full: H8178. sa 'ar I. שַׂ֫עַר noun [masculine] horror (properly bristling ); — ׳שׂ absolute, as accusative of congnate meaning with verb Ezek 27:35 ; 32:10 see foregoing; compare שׂ ׳אָֽחֲזוּ Job 18:20 (|| עַל נָשַׁמּוּ ).
